vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-12087
vulnerability.description: Out-of-bounds heap read in Perl Socket module's pack_ip_mreq_source() (Socket < 2.041).

statements.impact_statement: Asterion is a Python/FastAPI service; it executes no Perl and never calls Socket::pack_ip_mreq_source(). perl is a transitive Debian 'essential' dependency of the python:3.13-slim base image, not an application dependency. The vulnerable function requires a caller passing an attacker-controlled source argument shorter than 4 bytes, which has no reachable path in this service. No patched perl was available in Debian as of 2026-06-28; the base stage runs apt-get upgrade so the fix is absorbed automatically once published. NOTE: the product purl is pinned to perl@5.40.1-6 — if the package version changes (e.g. after a Debian update), this statement stops matching and the CVE re-surfaces for re-evaluation, which is the intended behavior.
